solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Dog worried sheep: pick another, finally

indicators.note: worried, like a dog with a bone, means these letters are shaken about into a new order
finally points to the closing letter of the word another

explanation.surface: A sheepdog harries the flock, and the shepherd is told to choose a different animal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worried' rearranges SHEEP and PICK together with R, the last letter of 'another'.
explanation.definitionFit: The schipperke is a small black Belgian breed, originally a barge guard dog.

clue.text: Desperate shop with tons to dispose of

indicators.note: to dispose of tells us to throw something away from the word for shop

parts.note: a store is a shop

explanation.surface: A shop in a bad way has heavy stock it urgently needs to get rid of.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to dispose of' removes T (tons) from STORE.
explanation.definitionFit: Sore in the older sense of severe or urgent, as in 'in sore need', matches desperate.

clue.text: Chemical pile, not a brown source of energy

indicators.note: not tells us the following a is to be left out of the word for pile

parts.note: a heap is a pile
tan is a light brown colour

indicators.note: source of means the beginning letter of energy

explanation.surface: A list of chemistry terms: a heap of something that isn't brown, used as a power source.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' drops A from HEAP to leave HEP; then TAN and E (first letter of 'energy').
explanation.definitionFit: Heptane is a hydrocarbon of the alkane series, a constituent of petrol, so a chemical.

clue.text: Label on boy without name in horrible prison compound

indicators.note: in places the label-and-boy assembly inside the reworked letters of prison
horrible suggests the word prison is mangled into a new shape
in a down clue, on means the first piece sits above the next

parts.note: a tag is a label

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the word for boy goes around name

parts.note: a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: A boy is tagged and sent to a dreadful jail, unnamed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, so the boy goes around the name; 'horrible' rearranges prison to PROSIN, and 'in' sets the label-and-boy run inside it; 'on' means above, in a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Prostaglandins are hormone-like lipid compounds found in body tissues.

clue.text: 4 Endeavour to put very loud men in sci-fi film

indicators.note: in tells us the loud-men pieces go inside the film title

parts.note: ET is Spielberg's 1982 science-fiction film
FF, fortissimo, is the musical marking for very loud
OR, other ranks, means ordinary soldiers, i.e. men

explanation.surface: A film director tries to cast some very noisy actors in a science-fiction movie.
explanation.walkthrough: The leading '4' is a stray number in the printed clue and plays no part; 'in' is the containment signal, and men as other ranks is a crossword staple.
explanation.definitionFit: An endeavour is an attempt or exertion, the same as an effort.

clue.text: Put an end to rubbish culture ultimately absorbed by youngster

indicators.note: absorbed by means the rubbish pieces are taken inside the word for youngster

parts.note: a kid is a youngster
bosh is nonsense, rubbish

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of culture

explanation.surface: A young person soaks up trashy culture until it puts an end to something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'absorbed by' is the containment signal; 'Put an end to' must be read as a past tense to match the -ED ending.
explanation.definitionFit: To put the kibosh on something is to stop it dead, so the verb means terminated.

clue.text: Grimacing, being devoid of fish in boat

indicators.note: being devoid of means lacking, so the fish is taken out of the grimacing word

parts.note: scowling is grimacing
the ling is a long sea fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: An angler pulls a face at having no catch on board.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being devoid of' removes LING from SCOWLING.
explanation.definitionFit: A scow is a flat-bottomed boat used for cargo.

clue.text: Time in bed, a long time, in type of hospital?

indicators.note: in puts the time abbreviation inside the word for bed

parts.note: a cot is a small bed
an age is a long time

explanation.surface: A patient spends ages in bed in some kind of hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: A cottage hospital is a small rural hospital, so the word qualifies a kind of hospital.

clue.text: See guerrilla struggle's origin in time of discontent?

indicators.note: in places the guerrilla and the letter inside the season

parts.note: the winter of discontent, from Richard III's opening line
Che Guevara, the revolutionary guerrilla leader

indicators.note: origin means the opening letter of struggle's

explanation.surface: A revolutionary struggle begins in a season of unrest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' looks like a verb but is a bishop's diocese; 'in' is the containment signal. The winter of discontent is Shakespeare's phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Winchester is an English cathedral city and the seat of a bishop, so a diocese.

clue.text: Theatre: something coming off there to loud cheers? Then disapproval

parts.note: rep is repertory theatre

parts.words: something coming off there to loud cheers?
parts.note: loud cheers are said to raise or lift the top of a building

explanation.surface: A theatre audience cheers wildly, then turns to disapproval.
explanation.walkthrough: 'there' is the theatre: noisy applause is said to raise the roof.
explanation.definitionFit: A reproof is a rebuke, an expression of disapproval.

clue.text: Composer the nation listened to

indicators.note: listened to means we want what the name of the nation sounds like when spoken

parts.note: Britain is the nation, for a British paper

explanation.surface: A composer the whole country tuned in to.
explanation.definitionFit: Benjamin Britten was the English composer of Peter Grimes and the War Requiem.

clue.text: Deem itinerant drunk to be unsettled

indicators.note: drunk suggests the letters stagger about into a different order

explanation.surface: We are told to regard a wandering drinker as unsettled.
explanation.definitionFit: Indeterminate means not fixed or decided, which is unsettled.

clue.text: Insincere person is held by agent and broken down somehow

indicators.note: held by means the person and is are put inside the agent word

parts.note: a fed is an FBI agent
an actor pretends, so is an insincere person

explanation.surface: A phoney is arrested by a government agent and somehow breaks down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'held by' is the containment signal; 'broken down somehow' hints at the mathematical sense rather than a collapse.
explanation.definitionFit: A number factorised is split into the numbers that multiply to give it, a mathematical breaking down.

clue.text: Money — about spent: what remains?

indicators.note: spent means used up and gone, so about is taken away from the money word

parts.note: cash is money
C, circa, means about

explanation.surface: With money nearly spent, someone asks what is left.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spent' removes C (about) from CASH.
explanation.definitionFit: Ash is the residue left after burning, the remains of a fire.

clue.text: High-ranking officer in broadcast — American with a plan being heard

parts.note: to air is to broadcast

indicators.note: being heard means we take how the American's surname sounds when spoken

parts.note: George Marshall, US Secretary of State, gave his name to the Marshall Plan for rebuilding post-war Europe

explanation.surface: A senior officer is broadcast while an American's plan is discussed.
explanation.definitionFit: An air marshal is a senior rank in the RAF, an officer of high rank.

clue.text: One given sentence finally in jail for the 'cooler years'

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: in places the sentence's end letter inside the word for jail

parts.note: a cage is a prison, a jail

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of sentence

explanation.surface: A prisoner sentenced to time in the cooler, slang for jail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooler' is slang for prison, but here it means colder. 'in' puts E inside CAGE.
explanation.definitionFit: An ice age is a long period of colder global climate, so cooler years.

clue.text: Achievement of female getting down

parts.note: a feat is an achievement
hers means belonging to a female

explanation.surface: A woman's achievement leaves her feeling low.
explanation.definitionFit: Down is the soft fluffy covering of birds, made of fine plumage.

clue.text: God's attitude I assume!

parts.note: a pose is an attitude, a bodily stance
to don is to put on or assume, as clothing

explanation.surface: A self-important person declares his own divine stance.
explanation.definitionFit: Poseidon is the Greek sea god.

clue.text: Mark article penned by journalist who seeks to resolve problem?

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for mark, the old German currency

indicators.note: penned by means the article is enclosed by the journalist word

parts.note: an editor is a journalist
A is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A journalist writes an article about a problem solver.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads as 'one who seeks to resolve a problem'. 'penned by' puts A inside EDITOR.
explanation.definitionFit: A mediator is a go-between who settles disputes between parties.

clue.text: Old letter in the morning glossy I'd flipped over

indicators.note: flipped over means the whole run is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: AM, ante meridiem, is the morning
a glossy is a glossy magazine, a mag

explanation.surface: A morning glossy magazine is turned over to find an old letter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flipped over' reverses AM, MAG and ID together, giving the pieces in reverse order.
explanation.definitionFit: The digamma was an early Greek letter, shaped like F, that dropped out of use.

clue.text: Quiet street abroad crossing a grand city

parts.note: P, piano, is the musical marking for quiet

indicators.note: crossing means the street goes across, i.e. around, the a-and-grand pair

parts.note: rue is the French word for street
G is slang for a grand, a thousand

explanation.surface: A quiet foreign street runs across a grand city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crossing' puts A and G inside RUE, after P.
explanation.definitionFit: Prague is the capital city of the Czech Republic.

clue.text: Group of baddies having trouble set up cell structures

parts.note: a gang is a group of criminals

indicators.note: set up in a down clue means the word for trouble is written upwards, backwards

parts.note: to ail is to trouble

explanation.surface: A gang of criminals is in trouble, framed in a prison cell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set up' reverses AIL to LIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Ganglia are clusters of nerve cell bodies, structures of the nervous system.

clue.text: Girl's firm, concealing a catastrophe

indicators.note: concealing means the girl's-firm pieces wrap around the letter a

parts.note: Fi, short for Fiona, is a girl; with the possessive s
CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm

explanation.surface: A young woman's company covers up a disaster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'concealing' puts the A between the girl's name and her possessive S.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiasco is a humiliating failure, a complete disaster.

clue.text: Having no end of pain, call doctor

indicators.note: having no means one letter is dropped from the word for call

parts.note: to ring is to call on the phone

indicators.note: end of picks the final letter of pain

explanation.surface: Someone in pain decides to phone the doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doctor' looks like the person to call, but it is the verb meaning falsify. 'Having no' removes N, end of 'pain', from RING.
explanation.definitionFit: To doctor results is to falsify or fix them, and rig has that sense.

clue.text: Artist's faced with decline — specialist health advisers needed

indicators.note: faced with means the decline word stands in front of the artist's

parts.note: to die away is to decline or fade
Titian, the Venetian painter, plus the possessive s

explanation.surface: An artist facing decline needs specialist health advice.
explanation.definitionFit: Dietitians are professionals who advise on nutrition and diet.

clue.text: Tease son not joining in dance

indicators.note: not joining in means the son stays out of the dance word

parts.note: the twist is a 1960s dance

explanation.surface: A teenage son is mocked for refusing to join a dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not joining in' removes S from TWIST.
explanation.definitionFit: To twit someone is to taunt or rib them, a mild form of teasing.

clue.text: Primate not half pious intellectual, I'll be bound

indicators.note: not half means only one half of the pious word is kept

parts.note: holy means pious

indicators.note: be bound means the I is tied up inside the intellect word

parts.note: a mind is an intellectual, a great thinker
I'll gives I, the subject of the phrase

explanation.surface: A sanctimonious thinker grumbles about a primate, insisting 'I'll be bound!'
explanation.walkthrough: 'I'll be bound' looks like an exclamation of certainty, but 'be bound' encloses the I; 'not half' keeps the first two letters of the pious word.
explanation.definitionFit: Hominids are the family of great apes, including humans, within the primates.

clue.text: Believe I may go south in winter

definitions.meaning: to ... a story is to accept it, believe it

definitions.text: I may go south in winter
definitions.meaning: a migratory bird that flies to warmer climes for the winter

explanation.definitionFit: To swallow a tale is to believe it; the swallow is a migrant bird wintering in Africa.

clue.text: Woman getting a husband after heartless lie

indicators.note: after means the a-and-husband pair follows the trimmed lie
heartless means the middle of the word lie is removed, keeping its ends

explanation.surface: A woman finds a husband after a cruel lie.
explanation.definitionFit: Leah is a woman's name; in Genesis she was Jacob's first wife.

clue.text: Racist perhaps managed to occupy home available for tenant

parts.note: in means at home

indicators.note: to occupy means managed moves into the home-and-tenant phrase

parts.note: to let is said of a property available to rent
ran means managed

explanation.surface: A racist runs a property and lets it to a tenant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to occupy' sends the managed word into the to-let phrase, between its E and T.
explanation.definitionFit: A racist is one example of a bigot who will not tolerate others.
